backup=/var/backups/inventory/inventory-20260901.tar.gz
target=/srv/inventory/data/config.json
other=/srv/inventory/data/current.txt
[ -f "$backup" ]
[ -f "$target" ]
[ -f "$other" ]
before_other_hash=$(sha256sum "$other" | awk '{print $1}')
before_other_meta=$(stat -c '%i|%s|%Y|%a|%u:%g' "$other")
source_hash=$(tar -xOzf "$backup" config.json | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
stage=$(mktemp -d /srv/inventory/data/.restore.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$stage"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
tar -xzf "$backup" -C "$stage" config.json
[ -f "$stage/config.json" ]
staged_hash=$(sha256sum "$stage/config.json" | awk '{print $1}')

mv -f "$stage/config.json" "$target"

after_other_hash=$(sha256sum "$other" | awk '{print $1}')
after_other_meta=$(stat -c '%i|%s|%Y|%a|%u:%g' "$other")

[ "$after_other_hash" = "$before_other_hash" ]
[ "$after_other_meta" = "$before_other_meta" ]
printf 'restored_from=%s\n' "$backup"

printf 'restored_config_sha256=%s\n' "$after_target_hash"
printf 'other_file_before_sha256=%s\n' "$before_other_hash"
